visual_review.notes: H3 video. The first attack whip ran off the top and the right side, so it was retaken with 128 px of room on three sides; the retake stays in frame except at full reach, so the attack skips those six frames and the last frame before them stands as the contact. The idle, hit, defend, cast and death are the first takes; the defend skips its rejected plates and the death drops from kneeling to lying in one step, as the video does. The walk loops on frames 33 to 93.
